_about: Story progress for Bible Stories. The weekly run reads this to know what is done and what comes next, and updates it after each release. Shelf data shown on the site lives in js/stories.js; chapter sources in tools/stories/<id>.js; the leaderboard list in netlify/functions/leaderboard.mjs (STORIES). Only released stories go into js/stories.js (with added:'<Monday>'); everything else waits here.

weekly_plan.volume: 2 new characters + 1 new event every Monday, chapters to fit each story (up to 4, never padded) - Dawn, Nov 28 2026 (replaces 4 characters a week)
weekly_plan.joseph_slot: finishing a character already on the shelf counts as one of the 2 character slots (Joseph ch 4-5 on Dec 7) - Dawn, Nov 28 2026
weekly_plan.shelf: only released stories show; no greyed coming-soon cards; 'New this week' for 7 days; the library only grows - Dawn, Nov 28 2026
weekly_plan.never_run_out: keep adding characters and events from across the Bible to the waiting list
weekly_plan.release_day: Monday; the week runs Monday-Sunday CT, like the Weekly Scheduler
weekly_plan.auto_go_live: yes, once all three checks pass (Dawn, Nov 27 2026)
weekly_plan.first_release: launch Mon Nov 30 2026 9:00 AM CT (Joseph 1-3, Christmas); first weekly release Mon Dec 7 2026

next.title: I Am Joseph
moments: Famine: the ten brothers come to Egypt to buy corn and bow down before the governor (42:3, 6); Joseph's dream comes true
Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew not him (42:8); he calls them spies, keeps Simeon bound, turns away and weeps (42:24)
They come back with Benjamin: 'God be gracious unto thee, my son' (43:29)
The silver cup in Benjamin's sack (44:2); Judah offers himself in Benjamin's place (44:33)
'I am Joseph your brother, whom ye sold into Egypt... God did send me before you to preserve life' (45:4-5)

next.title: God Meant It unto Good
moments: God speaks to Jacob in the visions of the night: 'fear not to go down into Egypt' (46:2-3); shown as light and a voice, God never drawn
Joseph meets his father in Goshen and weeps on his neck a good while (46:29)
Jacob before Pharaoh, 130 years old (47:9); the family settles in Goshen (47:6)
Jacob blesses Ephraim and Manasseh and sets Ephraim before Manasseh (48:20)
'Ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good' (50:20); 'ye shall carry up my bones from hence' (50:25)

joseph.note: Genesis 38 is about Judah, not Joseph, so it is not one of the Joseph chapters. Chapters 4-5 finish Joseph's story (Dec 7 2026); after them his card has no 'more'.

chapters_plan.title: The Shepherd Boy Is Chosen
moments: Samuel comes to Jesse's house in Bethlehem; the sons pass by; 'man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart' (16:7)
The youngest is keeping the sheep; David is anointed and the Spirit of the LORD comes upon him (16:11-13)
David plays the harp for troubled King Saul, and Saul is refreshed (16:14, 23)

chapters_plan.title: David and Goliath
moments: Goliath of Gath, six cubits and a span, defies Israel morning and evening for forty days (17:4, 16)
David brings food to his brothers; 'The LORD that delivered me out of the paw of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear' (17:34-37)
Five smooth stones out of the brook (17:40); 'I come to thee in the name of the LORD of hosts' (17:45)
The stone strikes his forehead and Goliath falls on his face (17:49-50); no gore shown

chapters_plan.title: Jonathan, a True Friend
moments: Jonathan's soul is knit with David's; he gives David his robe, sword and bow (18:1-4)
'Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands'; Saul is very wroth (18:7-8); the javelin, and David slips away (19:10)
The arrows signal; the two friends part in peace in the name of the LORD (20:22, 42)

chapters_plan.title: Mercy in the Cave
moments: Saul hunts David and goes into the very cave where David and his men are hiding (24:3)
David cuts off the skirt of Saul's robe but will not stretch out his hand against the LORD's anointed (24:4-6)
Saul: 'Thou art more righteous than I' (24:17)

david.later: David the king (2 Samuel) can come back as a returning character

christmas.content_choices: no wings on angels, no star over the manger, no donkey or stable animals (not in the text), the wise men visit a house (Matthew 2:11), their number is not given in Scripture

chapters_plan.title: Noah and the Flood
moments: Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD; build an ark of gopher wood, 300 by 50 by 30 cubits (6:8, 14-15); 'Thus did Noah' (6:22)
Two of every sort, and of every clean beast by sevens (6:19; 7:2); the LORD shut him in (7:16)
Rain forty days and forty nights (7:12); the ark rests upon the mountains of Ararat (8:4)
A raven, then the dove returns with an olive leaf (8:7-11)
Noah builds an altar (8:20); the bow in the cloud, God's covenant never to flood the earth again (9:13-15)

noah.content_choices: God is a voice and light, never drawn; the flood is shown as rain and rising water around the ark, no one shown drowning; clean beasts by sevens is mentioned so the 'two by two' is not misread

returning_characters: A character can come back in a later week with new chapters that continue the story (for example David's later years, Paul's journeys).
